## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit (`feat(scope): ...`, `fix: ...`, `chore: ...`)
- [ ] `bun run check` is green
- [ ] A changeset is added, or this is a `chore` and the description explains why none is needed
- [ ] Docs are updated (README, `docs/`, CONTRIBUTING) where behavior changed
- [ ] No API key, token or judge request/response body appears in the diff
